en: Color‑tinted photographic postcard showing two World War I soldiers flanking an allegorical female figure of France (Marianne). The soldier on the left, in a blue uniform, holds a red flag with a Union Jack canton, symbolizing the United Kingdom; the soldier on the right, in a khaki uniform, holds the French tricolour flag. The central woman wears a white classical dress with tricolour sash and a Phrygian cap adorned with laurel leaves. At the bottom is a patriotic French caption and the signature of the publisher or studio, along with the number 23.
